description: This file contains test helpers and mock implementations related to cookie store management in the Chromium project, including classes for delayed cookie operations, cookie URL handling, persistent store simulation, and callback counting.

classes.name: DelayedCookieMonsterChangeDispatcher
classes.description: Mock dispatcher for cookie change subscriptions, with methods to add callbacks for cookie changes.

classes.name: DelayedCookieMonster
classes.description: Mock implementation of a cookie monster that delays operations and manages cookie operations asynchronously.

classes.name: CookieURLHelper
classes.description: Helper class for URL manipulation and formatting related to cookies.

classes.name: FlushablePersistentStore
classes.description: Simulated persistent store for cookies with load and flush capabilities.

classes.name: CallbackCounter
classes.description: Utility class to count callback invocations.

methods.name: GetRegistry
methods.description: Extracts the registry part of a URL's host based on registry length.

methods.name: AppendPath
methods.description: Appends a path to the base URL.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string by replacing placeholders with domain and registry info.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads cookies asynchronously, simulating a delayed load.

methods.name: LoadCookiesForKey
methods.description: Loads cookies for a specific key, calls Load internally.

methods.name: SetCookiesInternalCallback
methods.description: Internal callback to set cookie access result.

methods.name: GetCookieListWithOptionsInternalCallback
methods.description: Internal callback to process retrieved cookie list.

methods.name: SetCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Sets a cookie asynchronously with a delay.

methods.name: GetCookieListWithOptionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cookie list asynchronously with a delay.

methods.name: GetAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies asynchronously.

methods.name: InvokeSetCookiesCallback
methods.description: Invokes the callback after setting cookies.

methods.name: InvokeGetCookieListCallback
methods.description: Invokes the callback after retrieving cookie list.

methods.name: DeleteCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Deletes a cookie asynchronously (failure in mock).

methods.name: DeleteAllCreatedInTimeRangeAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies in a time range (failure in mock).

methods.name: DeleteAllMatchingInfoAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies matching criteria (failure in mock).

methods.name: DeleteMatchingCookiesAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies based on predicate (failure in mock).

methods.name: DeleteSessionCookiesAsync
methods.description: Deletes session cookies (failure in mock).

methods.name: FlushStore
methods.description: Flushes the store (failure in mock).

methods.name: GetChangeDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the change dispatcher.

methods.name: SetCookieableSchemes
methods.description: Sets schemes for cookies (failure in mock).

methods.name: CookieURLHelper
methods.description: Helper class for URL formatting related to cookies.

methods.name: AppendPath
methods.description: Returns a URL with appended path.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in format string with URL info.

methods.name: FlushablePersistentStore
methods.description: Simulated persistent store with load and flush methods.

methods.name: CallbackCounter
methods.description: Counts callback invocations.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Increments callback count.
